_om: Tørsten in English (Thirsty, rusj.no/en/thirsty/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The cards are in data.en/kort.json. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Hvert kort begynner med «Jeg har aldri …: Every card starts with ‘Never have I ever …’. If you have done it, you take a small sip – at the same time as everyone else who has.
Mobilen viser hvem som leser. Les hele k: The phone shows who is reading. Read the whole card: ‘Never have I ever …’
Trykk på knappen. På «SKÅL!» løfter alle: Press the button. On ‘CHEERS!’ everyone who HAS done it raises their glass and takes a small sip.
Med vrien på kan dere på noen kort forte: With the twist on, some cards let you tell the story instead of drinking. At the end you crown the best story of the night.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit a card out – no explanation needed.
Hvert tiende kort er et vannkort. Da tar: Every tenth card is a water card. Then everyone has a sip of water.
You only tell as much as you want to.
Trykk på stjerna på kort som ga en god h: Tap the star on cards that gave a good story. They show up in the results.
Sveip kortet til siden for å hoppe over: Swipe the card to the side to skip it.
If you have, raise your glass.
På noen kort kan dere fortelle historien: Some cards let you tell the story instead of taking a sip.
You take turns reading the cards out loud.
A sip is a small sip – never more.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit a card out.
Every tenth card is a water card.
Har du gjort det? Løft glasset på «SKÅL!: Done it? Raise your glass on ‘CHEERS!’
Alkoholfritt teller like mye · alle kan: Alcohol-free counts too · anyone can sit out
Alle tar en slurk vann!: Everyone has a sip of water!
Skål i vann – kroppen takker, og kvelden: Cheers with water – your body will thank you, and the night lasts longer.
Hvem fortalte kveldens beste historie?: Who told the best story of the night?
Tell til tre og pek samtidig. Trykk på d: Count to three and all point at once. Tap whoever got the most fingers.
Remember water, food and a safe way home.
Skål! Har du gjort det: drikk – eller fo: Cheers! If you have done it: drink – or tell the story.
Skål! Har du gjort det, tar du en liten: Cheers! If you have done it, take a small sip.
You can always start a new one.
Til slutt kårer dere kveldens beste hist: Last of all, you crown the best story of the night.
You go straight to the results.
